origin: OpenCode 1.18.16 request with top-level fields the relay must not be sent (top_k, user, store, logprobs, prompt_cache_key, an unknown field) among those it is (temperature, top_p): derived from the capture. The capture asks for a Claude model; the model is changed to gpt-5.5 and reasoning_effort is the medium OpenCode sends for it (its verbosity field is left out, see extra-opencode-gpt-request-with-verbosity). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
